# SheetColumnType

<link-summary>What a schema column may hold.</link-summary>

<web-summary>SheetColumnType — What a schema column may hold. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>appsscript/sheet/types</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
type SheetColumnType = "string" | "number" | "boolean" | "date";
```

One of `"string"`, `"number"`, `"boolean"` or `"date"`. The four map onto what a spreadsheet cell can actually store, which is why the list is short: a cell holds text, a number, a checkbox or a date, and everything else is one of those in disguise.

## Examples

### Shape

```javascript
const type = "date";
```
